headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when Stokely Hathaway skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut in a "The Firm Deletion" match against The Hardys vs. Bill & Moriarty vs. Hook vs. Isiah Kassidy vs. Big Bill vs. Lee Moriarty vs. Ethan Page, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.43.
